text:
Maya (People Ops): Heads up — courier dropped an unlabelled medium box at the lobby pickup shelf, marked FRAGILE, left after 2 mins. No recipient name on the slip :thinking:
Tom K: Not me. Checked my deliveries this morning, nothing matches.
Jen L: Could be for infra? We had a hardware swap last week. Anyone from eng expecting a package?
Leo S: I signed for a small padded envelope earlier, not a box. This wasn't mine. Saw a note 'Atlas' on one side but no order #. :eyes:
Front Desk Bot: Package logged to mailroom system: TAG #LM-8142, status=unclaimed, location=Secure Locker 3. Photo saved as lm-8142.jpg.
Maya (People Ops): Thanks bot. I'm moving it to Locker 3 now. Locker code (for pickup at desk):
```
code: 8142
expires: 72h
```
Maya (People Ops): If you think it's yours, reply with your name + team and I'll verify with the courier receipt.
Tom K: @Maya (People Ops) i'm pretty sure the 'Atlas' label was for the CDN rack parts we had coming — pinged infra channel.
Jen L: Also FYI — hotdesk #7 (window side) is occupied by a vendor until 15:00. If anyone was planning to move there, heads up.
Leo S: Need a place for 30–60 mins, anyone flexible to swap from hotdesk 2?
Tom K: I can move from 2 -> bench near kitchen for an hour.
Jen L: I’ll keep hotdesk 2 for afternoon.
Maya (People Ops): Perfect — Tom, I put a sticky note on hotdesk 2 with your name. Also posting this in #general so remote folks know where to pick up packages.
Maya (People Ops): Quick reminder: if you find a package with ambiguous labels, snap a photo, put it in a locker, and tag me. Saves the 'who-ordered-a-banana' detective work later :banana: 
Leo S: thanks — locker instructions were clear. Will grab after my meeting.
Tom K: cheers! :thumbsup:
Maya (People Ops): Closing the loop — left a paper tag on the box with LM-8142 and my initials. If no one claims by EOD Friday it goes to lost-and-found for 14 days.
Front Desk Bot: Reminder set: 2026-03-27T17:00:00Z check for LM-8142.
Jen L: Love the process — low drama. :raised_hands:
Maya (People Ops): Teamwork!
